breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses only a gamma-centered k-point grid without any mention of a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh. The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified 'an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift' alongside gamma-centered sampling, which is contradictory. The generated specification resolves this by specifying only 'a gamma-centered grid to determine the Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid,' consistent with the ground truth which simply states 'Use a gamma-centered k-point grid and choose these settings yourself' without any half-shift instruction.
